title: A catch clause for an exception never thrown in the try block is unreachable

ground_truth.statement: The try block only multiplies an int by 2 and never throws UnusedDomainException, so the catch clause is unreachable.

mago.reason: Mago 1.60.2 implements dead-catch (introduced in 1.58.0) under [analyzer] check-dead-catch, but defaults both check-throws and check-dead-catch to false. Enabling both options in mago.toml emits dead-catch on this fixture.

notes: PHPStan 2.3.1 reports catch.neverThrown at line 15. Psalm 6.20.1 lacks dead-catch analysis and stays silent (recorded as false_negative). Mago 1.60.2 implements dead-catch behind check-throws = true and check-dead-catch = true, both false by default, so its baseline silence is recorded as an opt-in configuration divergence.
